definitions.GT_EXACT_CONFIRMED: Independently defensible exact physical property identity (street + house number + Taubaté, plus BC when independently obtainable).
definitions.GT_ADDRESS_CONFIRMED_BC_UNKNOWN: Exact street + exact house number independently established, but BC unavailable.
definitions.GT_UNRESOLVED: Anything weaker. Street only, neighbourhood only, coordinates only, broker reference alone, or CDN filename alone is unresolved.
